agencies.title:
Your idea.
Our headache.
agencies.p1: Send us the brief and the next day you get the fixed quote, the shooting plan and the names of who is coming. No ten-email thread.
agencies.p2: Whether it is an event with your client next to you or a three-day shoot, you will not have to keep an eye on us. We arrive early and whatever goes wrong, we sort it before anyone notices.
agencies.p3: On a campaign: first cut, final cut and versions for every format. On an event: a cut that same night and the aftermovie in 24-48 h. Your client sets the deadline, not our calendar.

servicesPage.title: What we do.
servicesPage.lead: Three lines of work, one crew and one standard: advertising's.
servicesPage.s1: Tell us what you need and within one working day you get a fixed quote, a shooting plan and an assigned crew.
servicesPage.s2: Technical meeting, locations, rider, running order and sign-off with you on every decision that affects the result.
servicesPage.s3: In-house crew and technical redundancy on the day. Staggered deliveries on the deadline your campaign sets.

agenciesPage.lead: We are the production company advertising, communication and event agencies bring to their projects. We do not compete with you: we produce what you have sold.

steps.d: Send us the brief. Within one working day you get a fixed quote, a shooting plan and the crew list.
No open items and no extras the day after. Travel, per diems and hours included.
We go through the script or running order, locations or venue, lighting, sound and live needs with your team.
A document with camera positions, timings, crew and kit. You approve it.
The crew you met in the meeting is the crew that shows up, be it a studio, a street or a conference centre. Redundancy in cameras, recording and sound.
On a campaign: first cut, final cut and versions for every format. On an event: social clips during, recap that night, aftermovie in 24-48 h and photos the same day.

need: Brief with objective, audience and deliverables
Script, storyboard or running order, if you have one

A production contact on your side

aboutPage.geo: On White is a video production company based in Seville, Spain, specialising in corporate events, conferences, commercials, branded content and corporate video. It works for event and communication agencies such as Nanook, Inusual, Santa Jarana, Marco de Comunicación and BeSpain, and for brands such as Xiaomi, JTI, Mastercard, Nissan and TCL. It has its own crew, a 100 m² studio and operates across Spain.
